cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved your cupboard as finished. The loose shelves preserve your freedom to choose heights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you fit the supports? They fall down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Adjustment is approved. This is the completed kit edition; you may arrange it around your tins.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid for installation. Can you use this drill and finish it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A demonstration is authorized. I'll fasten one shelf at your height: a finished sample. You may admire the remaining possibilities without rushing them.

reason: Make each practical request receive a granted reinterpretation of completion, with B drill causing one actual installed sample still sold as a thoughtful finished version.
